```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```
Family health worker receives complaints of weight gain from clients on contraceptives. He has also noticed & is aware that weight gain varies from individual to individual. He wants to find out if it is due to genetic variation or contraceptives. He compares 4 different contraceptive
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

anova_contra <- read_excel(here::here("data", "raw", "one_Way_ANOVA classwork_2022.xlsx"))
glimpse(anova_contra)
```

convert contraceptive to factor
```{r}
anova_contra$contraceptive <- as.factor(anova_contra$contraceptive)
class(anova_contra$contraceptive)
levels(anova_contra$contraceptive)
```

```{r}
View(anova_contra)
```

```{r}
#grandmean
mean(anova_contra$wtgain)
```
```{r}
#find mean in each categogory using dyplyr

anova_contra %>% 
  group_by(contraceptive) %>% 
  summarise(mean(wtgain))

#please note; the summarise function is different from summary as it only produces the specific calculation you want; so you have to tell it what you want calculate; mean
```
